description: Land Title Settlement Department - Etamurungagoda, Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320315
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and property details. The content is focused on land ownership, title registration, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily deals with land and property-related administrative matters.
